notes: Systemic: all 24 records are stubs with templated AI body text, no standard text. Several bodies carry copy-pasted boilerplate from a different topic (GB 26572, GB 34660, GB 8410, GB 44497). Template 'Related Regulations: Possible functional overlap' links are unrelated (e.g. GB 4094 under GB 44497, GB 9656 under GB 8410). AI un_equivalent_ai often wrong (R100/R153, R141/R142, R152, R21, R155 on non-cyber items). Status in-force used for standards whose effective date is in the future (GB 26572-2025, GB 34660-2026). Duplicate record GB 27887 vs GB 14167 anchorage topics conflated. Precheck had no flags for these items.
